Messages.Author: Darius
Messages.Body:
Hello everyone. I've just discovered JOL and I'm try to work it. How do you build a deck? In the same vein I noticed that Anarch revolt ha an export to JOL option. When it starts it says "Can't find image files in either '.' or 'vtesicons'!" and when I try to use the export to JOL feature it says "An error occurred while saving. Can't open XSL file" "An error occured while saving". Any idea whats wrong?

"Really, darling, you must not squirm so. It spoils the overall effect."

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
It seems likely that you are missing the deck2jol.xsl file.
In your ARDB 3.1 folder, do you have see ~15 XSL files?
You need those to do any sort of export.

The vtesicons folder will have ~81 xpm files.
The CardImages folder will have zip files.

I would recommend re-downloading the file and re-extracting it if you find any of those are missing.

code.google.com/p/ardb/downloads/list

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
The JOL export on ARDB will do it for you, no need to manually type out the deck.

The .JOL format used by the ARDB export has each card on one line, as originally required.
